name: eyeprolog.ts
description: EyeProlog turns facts and rules into answers and proofs.
author: Jos De Roo

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "fs.mkdirSync('dist/src/lib', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('src/lib', 'dist/src/lib', { recursive: true });"
scripts.generate: node tools/generate-library-autoload-index.mjs && node tools/generate-predicate-reference.mjs && node tools/extract-book-examples.mjs
scripts.preversion: npm test && node test/run-neumerkel.mjs --cached --update-report && node test/run-conformance-report.mjs conformance-report.md && git add test/conformance/NEUMERKEL-LATEST.md conformance-report.md
